environment.description: CI/CD pipeline OAuth plugin deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with TLS termination. The service is accessible at ci.internal.corp via Route53 private hosted zone. No additional request filtering or origin access restrictions. ALLOWED_REDIRECTS env var set to 'ci.internal.corp'. The ALB forwards all requests directly to the container on port 8443.

config.load_balancer: ALB with TLS termination, no WAF attached
config.network: VPC with public subnets, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
